fields.v: Proposes an approach; secondary: Proposes an evaluation method — the authors' own Cortex supervisory layer (pre-execution governance, requirement tracking, validation-repair loop) formalised as a fixed-point model with conditional theorems; Gauntlet evaluation protocol (five task families, VERTEX and build-gated scores, ASR estimators), with historical raw-vs-governed pilot observations reported descriptively
fields.quote: We study Cortex, a supervisory layer for pre-execution governance, requirement tracking, and iterative validation and repair. We formalize requirement closure on a finite lattice.
fields.why: Cortex is the authors' own tool (Alpha Omega Labs) and the paper formalises it and reports raw-vs-Cortex pilot comparisons with Q3-Q8 scored as empirical, which fits 'Proposes an approach' better than 'Conceptual'.
fields.doubt: O Cortex é da empresa dos autores e o artigo formaliza-o e compara-o (pilotos raw vs Cortex, pp. 15-17); também pontuaste Q3-Q8 como empírico. 'Proposes an approach' parece mais coerente que 'Conceptual'. Decide a natureza; Q13 aplica-se nos dois casos.
